name: GoHighLevel
description: Marketing/CRM platform for agencies (funnels, contacts, conversations, calendars, opportunities, payments) with a broad REST API v2.0.
access_notes: Developer Marketplace app registration is self-serve; for public/third-party apps HighLevel pushes OAuth 2.0 (location-level or agency-level, PKCE supported). For internal use, static Private Integration Tokens are generated directly from the account UI with scoped permissions. Using either requires a HighLevel account - plans are paid with a free trial; no permanent free tier.
mcp_notes: First-party LeadConnector MCP server: universal endpoint https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/mcp/ (any HTTP MCP client, OAuth or Private Integration Token) and per-client /mcp/anthropic/v2 endpoint with the full 625-operation catalog. Composio HIGHLEVEL toolkit also exists (218 tools, OAuth2, not Composio-managed).
uncertainty_notes: Exact current pricing/trial length not verified from an official pricing page; classification as self_serve_trial rests on HighLevel being a paid SaaS with self-serve signup while all API credential creation (marketplace apps, private integration tokens) is self-serve.

evidence.note: Private Integration Tokens: static scoped tokens generated from the UI, used as Bearer tokens against API v2.0 (services.leadconnectorhq.com)
Developer Marketplace OAuth 2.0 with location-level and agency-level access; PKCE supported; app registration through the marketplace
REST API covering contacts, conversations, calendars, opportunities, payments; 'Webhooks - Real-time notifications for 50+ events'
Official LeadConnector MCP server docs: /mcp/ universal endpoint and /mcp/anthropic/v2 full-catalog endpoint, auth via OAuth or Private Integration Token
Composio HIGHLEVEL toolkit: OAUTH2, 218 tools, 'Composio Managed App Available? No'
